title: PROPOSED ACQUISITION BY I&M REALTY (TANZANIA) LIMITED OF ASSETS FROM MWANAHAMISI ABDALLAH AZIZI
title_sw: PROPOSED ACQUISITION BY I&M REALTY (TANZANIA) LIMITED OF ASSETS FROM MWANAHAMISI ABDALLAH AZIZI
text:
I&M Realty (Tanzania) Limited notified the Fair Competition Commission (“FCC”) of their intention to acquire Assets from Mwanahamisi Abdallah Azizi.
The relevant market was defined as provision of commercial office space at Msasani Peninsula Area.
Based on the analysis, pre- and post-merger scenarios will remain the same for both perspectives of Section 5 (6) (a) and (b) of the FCA and thus having no possibility of either creating or strengthening a position of dominance in the relevant market. The merger was approved.
